en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Khalid b. Jarir from Abi’l Rabi` from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: My intercession anon will not be given to one who delays his obligatory prayers after their timing.
